title: 新武界引水隧道
summary: 台電典藏說明新武界及栗栖溪引水工程的規劃與施工，列16.5公里引水範圍及其中6.5公里TBM中段，記錄2002年該掘進段貫通。本課把土木、地質與水力目的串接，研究水路能量、探查代表性、支護和施工物流；這些尺度不被混寫成單一孔全長或發電容量。
summaryEn: Taipower describes planning and construction for New Wujie and Lixi conveyance, including a 16.5 km scope and a 6.5 km TBM middle section that broke through in 2002. This course connects civil, geological and hydraulic purposes through energy, investigation, support and logistics, without confusing those scopes with one bore length or generating capacity.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 原創綜合審查：先計算「破碎帶連通與預報更新」，再獨立計算「輸水摩阻與瞬變邊界」。原創教學假設：滲透係數=2e-06 m/s；水力坡降=2.1 無因次；通水面積=360 m²。Q=k i A=0.001512 m³/s。僅把滲透係數增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為0.0016632 m³/s。邊界：均質飽和達西流，不代表裂隙集中流；不是本工程實測或允收值。原創教學假設：達西因子=0.02 無因次；長度=1800 m；直徑=4 m；流速=2 m/s。hf=f(L/D)v²/(2g), g=9.81 m/s²=1.83486 m。僅把流速增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為2.22018 m。邊界：滿管穩態摩阻，不含水錘與局部損失；不是本工程實測或允收值。兩組結果的單位與邊界不同，不能直接相加。請列出一項缺少的現場輸入，說明它會影響哪個結論，以及哪種獨立量測可以縮小不確定度。
workedExample.textEn: Original integrated review: first calculate fault connectivity and forecast updating, then independently calculate conveyance friction and transient boundaries. Original teaching assumptions: conductivity=2e-06 m/s; hydraulic gradient=2.1 dimensionless; flow area=360 m². Q=k i A=0.001512 m³/s. Increasing only conductivity by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 0.0016632 m³/s. Boundary: Homogeneous saturated Darcy flow, not concentrated fracture flow. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Original teaching assumptions: Darcy factor=0.02 dimensionless; length=1800 m; diameter=4 m; velocity=2 m/s. hf=f(L/D)v²/(2g), g=9.81 m/s²=1.83486 m. Increasing only velocity by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 2.22018 m. Boundary: Steady full-pipe friction, excluding water hammer and local loss. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. The outputs have different units and boundaries and cannot simply be added. Identify one missing field input, explain which conclusion it changes and select an independent measurement to reduce uncertainty.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 地層條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.titleEn: Ground conditions, boundaries and engineering system
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「地下水路與傳遞時間」與「破碎帶連通與預報更新」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Underground water routes and travel time" and "Fault connectivity and forecast updating": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 地下水路與傳遞時間：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Underground water routes and travel time: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「水體平流時間」如何影響新武界引水隧道的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Water advection time” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “New Wujie water-conveyance tunnel”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 新武界是引水工程，路線由取水、出口水位和能量坡度決定，教材用水體平流而非車輛旅行時間。地下排水或引水設施的路線先由集水區、入流點、出口水位及坡度定義，不能以交通旅行時間衡量。定速水體的行程可用距離除速度估算，但洪峰波速、蓄水與回水會改變訊號傳遞；各支路必須在共同水位與時間基準下連接。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「水體平流時間」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: New Wujie is a conveyance work; intake, outlet level and energy gradient define the route, so the example uses water advection rather than vehicle travel. An underground water route is defined by catchments, inflows, outfall level and gradient, not vehicle journey time. Distance divided by velocity estimates constant-speed material travel, while flood-wave celerity, storage and backwater alter signal propagation. Branches must be connected using common level and time references before interpreting arrival or control response. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Water advection time” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：水路長度=2000 m；水體速度=1.5 m/s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: reach length=2000 m; water velocity=1.5 m/s. t=L/v/60=22.2222 min.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「水體流過全程的時間必然等於洪峰抵達的時間。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Material travel time necessarily equals flood-peak arrival time." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「水體平流時間」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Water advection time”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 地下水路與傳遞時間：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Underground water routes and travel time: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「水體平流時間」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Water advection time” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：水路長度=2000 m；水體速度=1.5 m/s。t=L/v/60=22.2222 min。僅把水路長度增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為24.4444 min。邊界：定速水體平流，不是洪峰波速或完整洪水演算；不是本工程實測或允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: reach length=2000 m; water velocity=1.5 m/s. t=L/v/60=22.2222 min. Increasing only reach length by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 24.4444 min. Boundary: Constant-speed water advection, not flood-wave celerity or complete routing. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：核對上下游水位基準和各引水支路的連接範圍。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check level datum and connection scope for upstream, downstream and branch inflows.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：水路長度=2000 m；水體速度=1.5 m/s。t=L/v/60=22.2222 min。僅把水路長度增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為24.4444 min。邊界：定速水體平流，不是洪峰波速或完整洪水演算；不是本工程實測或允收值。

Boundary: Constant-speed water advection, not flood-wave celerity or complete routing. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.

steps.title: 地下水路與傳遞時間：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Underground water routes and travel time: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「水體平流時間」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Water advection time” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 核對上下游水位基準和各引水支路的連接範圍。對齊入口與出口水位流量時間序列，利用允許的示蹤或模型比較平流時間與洪峰時差，保留回水條件。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check level datum and connection scope for upstream, downstream and branch inflows. Align inlet and outlet level-flow histories; use permitted tracer data or modelling to distinguish material travel from peak lag while preserving backwater conditions. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：本案「水體平流時間」的交付需回答：核對上下游水位基準和各引水支路的連接範圍。路線圖同時標示水位基準、支路與控制邊界，所有時間比較註明是物質、波峰或設備延遲，避免混用。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: For New Wujie water-conveyance tunnel, the water advection time handover must address the following evidence: Check level datum and connection scope for upstream, downstream and branch inflows. Route diagrams show level datum, branches and control boundaries; label each time as material travel, wave propagation or equipment delay.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把引水長度直接換成交通效益會完全失去功能邊界。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Converting conveyance length into a traffic benefit loses the functional boundary. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.question: 要驗證「地下水路與傳遞時間」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Underground water routes and travel time"?
options: 核對上下游水位基準和各引水支路的連接範圍。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、開挖序列與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。

steps.title: 地下水路與傳遞時間：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Underground water routes and travel time: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「水體平流時間」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Water advection time” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把引水長度直接換成交通效益會完全失去功能邊界。把平流時間當洪峰預警時間會忽略波速和支路入流，控制指令可能在假定水體到達之前已失去適用性。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Converting conveyance length into a traffic benefit loses the functional boundary. Using advection time as flood-warning time ignores celerity and side inflows, allowing control assumptions to fail before the assumed arrival. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：定速水體的行程可用距離除速度估算，但洪峰波速、蓄水與回水會改變訊號傳遞；各支路必須在共同水位與時間基準下連接。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Branches must be connected using common level and time references before interpreting arrival or control response.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「水體流過全程的時間必然等於洪峰抵達的時間。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Material travel time necessarily equals flood-peak arrival time." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 把引水長度直接換成交通效益會完全失去功能邊界。把平流時間當洪峰預警時間會忽略波速和支路入流，控制指令可能在假定水體到達之前已失去適用性。
knowledge.textEn: Converting conveyance length into a traffic benefit loses the functional boundary. Using advection time as flood-warning time ignores celerity and side inflows, allowing control assumptions to fail before the assumed arrival.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「地下水路與傳遞時間」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Underground water routes and travel time" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。

steps.title: 破碎帶連通與預報更新：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Fault connectivity and forecast updating: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「破碎帶連通性」如何影響新武界引水隧道的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Fault-zone connectivity” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “New Wujie water-conveyance tunnel”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 台電記錄強調探查與機械配合，本課研究長水平孔的岩性代表性及未探區裂隙不確定度。斷層帶可以含很硬的岩塊，但整體變形與湧水常由填充節理和連通裂隙控制。單一岩芯強度不能代表整個掌子面；超前鑽孔、出水變化與揭露地質須回饋同一里程模型，預報則應保留不同情境及其證據權重。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「破碎帶連通性」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Taipower emphasises investigation-machine coordination; examine representativeness of a long horizontal probe and fracture uncertainty outside it. A fault zone may contain strong intact blocks while filled joints and connected fractures govern its bulk deformation and inflow. One core strength does not represent the entire face. Probe records, water response and exposed geology must update a common chainage model, preserving competing interpretations and their evidential weight rather than treating a forecast as certainty. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Fault-zone connectivity” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：滲透係數=2e-06 m/s；水力坡降=2.1 無因次；通水面積=360 m²。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: conductivity=2e-06 m/s; hydraulic gradient=2.1 dimensionless; flow area=360 m².
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「岩芯很硬就可以排除破碎帶變形與集中湧水。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Hard intact core excludes fault-zone deformation and concentrated inflow." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「破碎帶連通性」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Fault-zone connectivity”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 破碎帶連通與預報更新：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Fault connectivity and forecast updating: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「破碎帶連通性」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Fault-zone connectivity” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：滲透係數=2e-06 m/s；水力坡降=2.1 無因次；通水面積=360 m²。Q=k i A=0.001512 m³/s。僅把滲透係數增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為0.0016632 m³/s。邊界：均質飽和達西流，不代表裂隙集中流；不是本工程實測或允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: conductivity=2e-06 m/s; hydraulic gradient=2.1 dimensionless; flow area=360 m². Q=k i A=0.001512 m³/s. Increasing only conductivity by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 0.0016632 m³/s. Boundary: Homogeneous saturated Darcy flow, not concentrated fracture flow. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以後續揭露核對探孔預測，標記偏離路線的取樣區。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check probe predictions against later exposure and mark sampled areas away from the alignment.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：滲透係數=2e-06 m/s；水力坡降=2.1 無因次；通水面積=360 m²。Q=k i A=0.001512 m³/s。僅把滲透係數增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為0.0016632 m³/s。邊界：均質飽和達西流，不代表裂隙集中流；不是本工程實測或允收值。

Increasing only conductivity by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 0.0016632 m³/s. Boundary: Homogeneous saturated Darcy flow, not concentrated fracture flow. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.

knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「破碎帶連通與預報更新」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？

options: 原創教學假設：滲透係數=2e-06 m/s；水力坡降=2.1 無因次；通水面積=360 m²。
支護越厚越硬就一定能解決所有擠壓性地層。

Thicker and stiffer support necessarily solves every squeezing-ground problem.
Passing concrete strength eliminates the need to check joint rotation and uneven pressure.

steps.title: 破碎帶連通與預報更新：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Fault connectivity and forecast updating: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「破碎帶連通性」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Fault-zone connectivity” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以後續揭露核對探孔預測，標記偏離路線的取樣區。將岩心回收、裂隙方位與出水曲線按里程對齊，用未參與建模的孔段作交叉檢驗，檢查是否只擬合已知資料。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check probe predictions against later exposure and mark sampled areas away from the alignment. Align recovery, fracture orientation and inflow by chainage; test the interpretation against a withheld borehole interval to detect fitting only the known observations. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：本案「破碎帶連通性」的交付需回答：以後續揭露核對探孔預測，標記偏離路線的取樣區。每次地質模型更新保留舊版與新增證據，差異由地質及支護設計者共同判讀，施工條件改變需重新確認核准範圍。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: For New Wujie water-conveyance tunnel, the fault-zone connectivity handover must address the following evidence: Check probe predictions against later exposure and mark sampled areas away from the alignment. Retain previous interpretations and new evidence at every update; geology and support designers jointly interpret differences and reconfirm approved bounds when ground conditions change.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：一支長孔仍可能平行錯過不利構造，長度不等於完整覆蓋。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A long hole can run parallel to an adverse structure; length is not complete coverage. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.text: 以後續揭露核對探孔預測，標記偏離路線的取樣區。將岩心回收、裂隙方位與出水曲線按里程對齊，用未參與建模的孔段作交叉檢驗，檢查是否只擬合已知資料。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。

Align recovery, fracture orientation and inflow by chainage; test the interpretation against a withheld borehole interval to detect fitting only the known observations. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 本案「破碎帶連通性」的交付需回答：以後續揭露核對探孔預測，標記偏離路線的取樣區。每次地質模型更新保留舊版與新增證據，差異由地質及支護設計者共同判讀，施工條件改變需重新確認核准範圍。

Retain previous interpretations and new evidence at every update; geology and support designers jointly interpret differences and reconfirm approved bounds when ground conditions change.

quiz.question: 要驗證「破碎帶連通與預報更新」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Fault connectivity and forecast updating"?
options: 沿用另一條隧道或另一處地層的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
以後續揭露核對探孔預測，標記偏離路線的取樣區。
增加工作面就可以直接把各面的理論產量相加。

Check probe predictions against later exposure and mark sampled areas away from the alignment.
Adding headings allows their theoretical outputs to be summed directly.
quiz.explanation: 以後續揭露核對探孔預測，標記偏離路線的取樣區。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Check probe predictions against later exposure and mark sampled areas away from the alignment. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 破碎帶連通與預報更新：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Fault connectivity and forecast updating: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「破碎帶連通性」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Fault-zone connectivity” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 一支長孔仍可能平行錯過不利構造，長度不等於完整覆蓋。只用完整岩石強度會漏掉軟弱填充物，可能在看似堅硬的地層中出現收斂加快、支護過載或水量突增。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A long hole can run parallel to an adverse structure; length is not complete coverage. Intact strength alone misses weak infill, allowing accelerating convergence, support overload or sudden inflow in ground that superficially appears strong. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：單一岩芯強度不能代表整個掌子面；超前鑽孔、出水變化與揭露地質須回饋同一里程模型，預報則應保留不同情境及其證據權重。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Probe records, water response and exposed geology must update a common chainage model, preserving competing interpretations and their evidential weight rather than treating a forecast as certainty.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「岩芯很硬就可以排除破碎帶變形與集中湧水。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Hard intact core excludes fault-zone deformation and concentrated inflow." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 一支長孔仍可能平行錯過不利構造，長度不等於完整覆蓋。只用完整岩石強度會漏掉軟弱填充物，可能在看似堅硬的地層中出現收斂加快、支護過載或水量突增。
knowledge.textEn: A long hole can run parallel to an adverse structure; length is not complete coverage. Intact strength alone misses weak infill, allowing accelerating convergence, support overload or sudden inflow in ground that superficially appears strong.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「破碎帶連通與預報更新」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Fault connectivity and forecast updating" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
目前沒有可見漏水就能在設計中忽略外水壓。
一支長孔仍可能平行錯過不利構造，長度不等於完整覆蓋。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
No visible leakage means that external water pressure can be omitted from design.
A long hole can run parallel to an adverse structure; length is not complete coverage.
quiz.explanation: 一支長孔仍可能平行錯過不利構造，長度不等於完整覆蓋。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A long hole can run parallel to an adverse structure; length is not complete coverage. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 機制、材料與定量設計
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「測壓水頭與襯砌外壓」與「掘進利用率與設備停時」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Piezometric head and lining pressure" and "Boring utilisation and equipment downtime": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 測壓水頭與襯砌外壓：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Piezometric head and lining pressure: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「測壓水頭」如何影響新武界引水隧道的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Piezometric head” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “New Wujie water-conveyance tunnel”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 引水隧道施工時外部地下水與營運時內水壓方向不同，教材把內外壓組合按階段列清。水壓取決於連通含水層的測壓水頭，不必等於地表或海面至洞頂的幾何深度。排水降低水壓卻可能增加有效應力與沉陷；停泵或排水堵塞後水頭又會回升，因此防水、排水及環境保水是互相制約的設計選擇。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「測壓水頭」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: External groundwater during excavation and internal conveyance pressure during operation act differently; list pressure combinations by stage. Water pressure follows piezometric head in the connected aquifer, not automatically the geometric depth below ground or sea level. Drainage reduces pressure but can increase effective stress and settlement. Head may recover after a pump outage or blockage, coupling waterproofing, drainage capacity and preservation of surrounding groundwater in the permanent design. steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「支護安裝時點」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Support activation time” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 初期支護穩定不能證明永久水理斷面已達需求。過晚封閉會讓不可回復變形增加，過硬且行程不足的支護也可能脆裂，兩者都可能表現為裂縫而需不同處理。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Stable initial support does not establish the permanent hydraulic section. Late closure increases irreversible movement, while excessively stiff support with little travel can fail brittly; both produce cracks but require different diagnoses. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.

steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Squeezing ground also needs deformation capacity; high stiffness and material strength alone do not guarantee a compatible support response.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「支護越厚越硬就一定能解決所有擠壓性地層。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Thicker and stiffer support necessarily solves every squeezing-ground problem." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。

steps.title: 輸水摩阻與瞬變邊界：機制與系統路徑

steps.objective: 說明「滿管沿程損失」如何影響新武界引水隧道的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Full-pipe friction loss” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “New Wujie water-conveyance tunnel”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 新武界水理教材以滿管摩阻建立能量帳，再列閘門瞬變和可能自由水面轉換的額外需求。輸水隧道由上下游能量差驅動，沿程粗糙度、接頭及局部收縮消耗水頭；流速增加使摩阻快速上升。穩態滿管式不能描述水錘、自由水面轉換或氣囊，閘門動作和停機歷程必須另外建立瞬變模型與通氣條件。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「滿管沿程損失」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Build a full-pipe friction balance, then identify separate gate-transient and possible free-surface-transition requirements. A conveyance tunnel is driven by upstream and downstream energy levels; roughness, joints and contractions consume head, with friction rising rapidly with velocity. A steady full-pipe equation does not describe water hammer, free-surface transitions or trapped air. Gate movements and shutdown histories require separate transient modelling and explicit ventilation conditions. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Full-pipe friction loss” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：達西因子=0.02 無因次；長度=1800 m；直徑=4 m；流速=2 m/s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: Darcy factor=0.02 dimensionless; length=1800 m; diameter=4 m; velocity=2 m/s. hf=f(L/D)v²/(2g), g=9.81 m/s²=1.83486 m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只算穩態流量就能排除輸水隧道的水錘與氣囊。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A steady-flow calculation excludes water hammer and trapped air in a conveyance tunnel." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「滿管沿程損失」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Lining hoop compression” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “New Wujie water-conveyance tunnel”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 引水內襯的平整度和接縫同時影響摩阻與結構，教材將環向量級和局部缺陷分開。圓形襯砌對均勻外壓可主要以環向壓縮抵抗，但接頭轉動、偏壓與背填空隙會引起彎矩。薄環膜應力只說明其中一條受力路徑；脫模、運輸、頂推及永久狀態的荷載不同，環片局部接觸與止水條件必須另外檢核。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「襯砌環向壓縮」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Lining smoothness and joints affect hydraulics and structure; separate hoop-force scale from local defects. A circular lining resists uniform external pressure largely through hoop compression, but joint rotation, uneven load and backfill voids generate bending. Thin-ring membrane stress describes only one load path. Demoulding, transport, jacking and permanent states impose different actions, requiring separate checks of local segment contact and sealing rather than one permanent-load calculation. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Lining hoop compression” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

quiz.explanation: 角度閉合好不證明縱斷面水準沒有系統偏差。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Good angular closure does not establish an unbiased longitudinal level profile. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「共享通道與運輸瓶頸」與「水量帳與環境受體」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Shared access and transport bottlenecks" and "Water balance and environmental receptors": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 共享通道與運輸瓶頸：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Shared access and transport bottlenecks: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「出渣運輸節拍」如何影響新武界引水隧道的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Muck-transport cycle” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “New Wujie water-conveyance tunnel”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 山區引水工程多面施工仍受材料、出渣及維修通道限制，教材把機械產能與供應節拍分開。多工作面只有在供電、通風、出渣與材料供應同步充足時才增加總產量。共用豎井或軌道形成串聯瓶頸，排隊和維修窗口會降低名目容量；緩衝區太大又可能侵占通行與救援空間，因此不能單純把各面產能相加。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「出渣運輸節拍」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Multiple mountain headings remain limited by material, spoil and maintenance access; distinguish machine capacity from supply cycle. Multiple headings increase output only when power, air, muck transport and materials support them together. Shared shafts or railways become serial bottlenecks, while queues and maintenance reduce nominal capacity. Large buffers may obstruct personnel and rescue access, so face capacities cannot simply be added without a network-level transport and storage check. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Muck-transport cycle” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：車輛數=4 個；每車載量=36 t；往返週期=38 min。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: vehicles=4 count; payload=36 t; cycle=38 min.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「增加工作面就可以直接把各面的理論產量相加。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Adding headings allows their theoretical outputs to be summed directly." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「出渣運輸節拍」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Muck-transport cycle”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 共享通道與運輸瓶頸
knowledge.text: 山區引水工程多面施工仍受材料、出渣及維修通道限制，教材把機械產能與供應節拍分開。多工作面只有在供電、通風、出渣與材料供應同步充足時才增加總產量。
knowledge.textEn: Multiple mountain headings remain limited by material, spoil and maintenance access; distinguish machine capacity from supply cycle. Multiple headings increase output only when power, air, muck transport and materials support them together.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：增加工作面就可以直接把各面的理論產量相加。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Adding headings allows their theoretical outputs to be summed directly. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「共享通道與運輸瓶頸」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Shared access and transport bottlenecks" is correct?
options: 山區引水工程多面施工仍受材料、出渣及維修通道限制，教材把機械產能與供應節拍分開。
增加工作面就可以直接把各面的理論產量相加。
施工後泉水變少就能單獨證明隧道造成全部減流。

Reduced spring flow after construction alone proves the tunnel caused the entire change.
quiz.explanation: 山區引水工程多面施工仍受材料、出渣及維修通道限制，教材把機械產能與供應節拍分開。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Multiple mountain headings remain limited by material, spoil and maintenance access; distinguish machine capacity from supply cycle. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 共享通道與運輸瓶頸：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Shared access and transport bottlenecks: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「出渣運輸節拍」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Muck-transport cycle” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：車輛數=4 個；每車載量=36 t；往返週期=38 min。C=N payload 60/T=227.368 t/h。僅把往返週期增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為206.699 t/h。邊界：無排隊理想循環，並非共享路段實際產能；不是本工程實測或允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: vehicles=4 count; payload=36 t; cycle=38 min. C=N payload 60/T=227.368 t/h. Increasing only cycle by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 206.699 t/h. Boundary: Ideal cycle without queues, not actual shared-route production. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：核對環片或內襯材料、刀具和出渣的共用占時。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check shared access time for lining materials, cutters and spoil.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：車輛數=4 個；每車載量=36 t；往返週期=38 min。C=N payload 60/T=227.368 t/h。僅把往返週期增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為206.699 t/h。邊界：無排隊理想循環，並非共享路段實際產能；不是本工程實測或允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: vehicles=4 count; payload=36 t; cycle=38 min. C=N payload 60/T=227.368 t/h. Increasing only cycle by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 206.699 t/h. Boundary: Ideal cycle without queues, not actual shared-route production. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「共享通道與運輸瓶頸」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Shared access and transport bottlenecks", which statement holds?
options: 岩芯很硬就可以排除破碎帶變形與集中湧水。
原創教學假設：車輛數=4 個；每車載量=36 t；往返週期=38 min。
刀盤瞬間轉得更快就保證全工程平均進尺更高。
optionsEn: Hard intact core excludes fault-zone deformation and concentrated inflow.
Original teaching assumptions: vehicles=4 count; payload=36 t; cycle=38 min.

steps.title: 共享通道與運輸瓶頸：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Shared access and transport bottlenecks: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「出渣運輸節拍」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Muck-transport cycle” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 核對環片或內襯材料、刀具和出渣的共用占時。以裝載質量、往返時間及排隊時間重建物流曲線，再核對緩衝占用、共用通道優先權與維修時段。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check shared access time for lining materials, cutters and spoil. Reconstruct flow from payload, round-trip and queue times, then check buffer occupancy, shared-route priorities and maintenance periods. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：本案「出渣運輸節拍」的交付需回答：核對環片或內襯材料、刀具和出渣的共用占時。每日排程同時標示人員、材料和維修的占用時段，任何物流改線先檢查通風與應變通道，不能只看運量提升。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: For New Wujie water-conveyance tunnel, the muck-transport cycle handover must address the following evidence: Check shared access time for lining materials, cutters and spoil. Schedules show personnel, materials and maintenance occupancy together; rerouting first checks ventilation and emergency access rather than only throughput gains.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：出渣優先若排擠刀具維修會降低後續有效切削時間。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Spoil priority that displaces cutter maintenance reduces later productive cutting. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 核對環片或內襯材料、刀具和出渣的共用占時。以裝載質量、往返時間及排隊時間重建物流曲線，再核對緩衝占用、共用通道優先權與維修時段。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。
knowledge.textEn: Check shared access time for lining materials, cutters and spoil. Reconstruct flow from payload, round-trip and queue times, then check buffer occupancy, shared-route priorities and maintenance periods. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 本案「出渣運輸節拍」的交付需回答：核對環片或內襯材料、刀具和出渣的共用占時。每日排程同時標示人員、材料和維修的占用時段，任何物流改線先檢查通風與應變通道，不能只看運量提升。
knowledge.textEn: For New Wujie water-conveyance tunnel, the muck-transport cycle handover must address the following evidence: Check shared access time for lining materials, cutters and spoil. Schedules show personnel, materials and maintenance occupancy together; rerouting first checks ventilation and emergency access rather than only throughput gains.

quiz.question: 要驗證「共享通道與運輸瓶頸」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Shared access and transport bottlenecks"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
只算穩態流量就能排除輸水隧道的水錘與氣囊。
核對環片或內襯材料、刀具和出渣的共用占時。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
A steady-flow calculation excludes water hammer and trapped air in a conveyance tunnel.
Check shared access time for lining materials, cutters and spoil.
quiz.explanation: 核對環片或內襯材料、刀具和出渣的共用占時。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Check shared access time for lining materials, cutters and spoil. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 共享通道與運輸瓶頸：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Shared access and transport bottlenecks: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「出渣運輸節拍」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Muck-transport cycle” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 出渣優先若排擠刀具維修會降低後續有效切削時間。把理想往返時間當全天常數會忽略交會等待與卸料堵塞，導致工作面停工或把材料堆入必要通道。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Spoil priority that displaces cutter maintenance reduces later productive cutting. Treating an ideal cycle as constant all day misses passing delays and unloading blockages, stopping headings or pushing material into essential access space. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：共用豎井或軌道形成串聯瓶頸，排隊和維修窗口會降低名目容量；緩衝區太大又可能侵占通行與救援空間，因此不能單純把各面產能相加。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Large buffers may obstruct personnel and rescue access, so face capacities cannot simply be added without a network-level transport and storage check.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「增加工作面就可以直接把各面的理論產量相加。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Adding headings allows their theoretical outputs to be summed directly." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 出渣優先若排擠刀具維修會降低後續有效切削時間。把理想往返時間當全天常數會忽略交會等待與卸料堵塞，導致工作面停工或把材料堆入必要通道。
knowledge.textEn: Spoil priority that displaces cutter maintenance reduces later productive cutting. Treating an ideal cycle as constant all day misses passing delays and unloading blockages, stopping headings or pushing material into essential access space.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「共享通道與運輸瓶頸」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Shared access and transport bottlenecks" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 出渣優先若排擠刀具維修會降低後續有效切削時間。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
施工後泉水變少就能單獨證明隧道造成全部減流。
optionsEn: Spoil priority that displaces cutter maintenance reduces later productive cutting.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
Reduced spring flow after construction alone proves the tunnel caused the entire change.
quiz.explanation: 出渣優先若排擠刀具維修會降低後續有效切削時間。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Spoil priority that displaces cutter maintenance reduces later productive cutting. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 水量帳與環境受體：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Water balance and environmental receptors: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「邊界水量差」如何影響新武界引水隧道的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Boundary water-balance residual” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “New Wujie water-conveyance tunnel”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 引水目的與施工排水可能改變不同流域受體，本課以水量帳區分轉移水、地層滲水和天然補注。隧道排水可能改變泉水、溪流或地下水補注，但同時還有降雨、季節與既有抽水等影響。水量平衡需要明確時間和空間邊界，殘差不能直接歸因於某一裂隙；應用施工前基線和對照站區分自然變化與工程效應。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「邊界水量差」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Conveyance and construction drainage affect different receptors; separate transferred water, groundwater inflow and natural recharge. Tunnel drainage may alter springs, streams or groundwater recharge, alongside rainfall, seasonal change and existing abstraction. A water balance needs explicit temporal and spatial boundaries; its residual cannot be assigned directly to one fracture. Baseline observations and control locations help separate natural variability from construction effects rather than equating correlation with causation. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Boundary water-balance residual” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：流入=148 m³/day；流出=79 m³/day；其他損失=20 m³/day。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: inflow=148 m³/day; outflow=79 m³/day; other loss=20 m³/day. ΔS=I−O−loss=49 m³/day.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「施工後泉水變少就能單獨證明隧道造成全部減流。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Reduced spring flow after construction alone proves the tunnel caused the entire change." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「邊界水量差」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Boundary water-balance residual”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 水量帳與環境受體
knowledge.text: 引水目的與施工排水可能改變不同流域受體，本課以水量帳區分轉移水、地層滲水和天然補注。隧道排水可能改變泉水、溪流或地下水補注，但同時還有降雨、季節與既有抽水等影響。
knowledge.textEn: Conveyance and construction drainage affect different receptors; separate transferred water, groundwater inflow and natural recharge. Tunnel drainage may alter springs, streams or groundwater recharge, alongside rainfall, seasonal change and existing abstraction.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：施工後泉水變少就能單獨證明隧道造成全部減流。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Reduced spring flow after construction alone proves the tunnel caused the entire change. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「水量帳與環境受體」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Water balance and environmental receptors" is correct?
options: 施工後泉水變少就能單獨證明隧道造成全部減流。
引水目的與施工排水可能改變不同流域受體，本課以水量帳區分轉移水、地層滲水和天然補注。
水體流過全程的時間必然等於洪峰抵達的時間。
optionsEn: Reduced spring flow after construction alone proves the tunnel caused the entire change.
Conveyance and construction drainage affect different receptors; separate transferred water, groundwater inflow and natural recharge.
Material travel time necessarily equals flood-peak arrival time.
quiz.explanation: 引水目的與施工排水可能改變不同流域受體，本課以水量帳區分轉移水、地層滲水和天然補注。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Conveyance and construction drainage affect different receptors; separate transferred water, groundwater inflow and natural recharge. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 水量帳與環境受體：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Water balance and environmental receptors: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「邊界水量差」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Boundary water-balance residual” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：流入=148 m³/day；流出=79 m³/day；其他損失=20 m³/day。ΔS=I−O−loss=49 m³/day。僅把流入增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為63.8 m³/day。邊界：指定邊界日水量帳，不是因果或含水層參數證明；不是本工程實測或允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: inflow=148 m³/day; outflow=79 m³/day; other loss=20 m³/day. ΔS=I−O−loss=49 m³/day. Increasing only inflow by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 63.8 m³/day. Boundary: Daily balance in a stated boundary, not causal proof or aquifer-parameter identification. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：明示集水區和時間邊界，以對照點核對季節變化。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: State catchment and time boundaries and use controls to check seasonality.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

steps.title: 水量帳與環境受體：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Water balance and environmental receptors: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「邊界水量差」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Boundary water-balance residual” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 明示集水區和時間邊界，以對照點核對季節變化。同步比較雨量、泉流、排水與對照井，核對儀器缺測和蓄水變化，對不同季節分別閉合水量帳。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: State catchment and time boundaries and use controls to check seasonality. Compare rainfall, spring flow, drainage and control wells, checking missing data and storage change and closing balances separately by season. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：本案「邊界水量差」的交付需回答：明示集水區和時間邊界，以對照點核對季節變化。預先定義受體、基線及資料缺口，任何因果判斷都需列出替代解釋，補救效果也用同一監測邊界評估。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: For New Wujie water-conveyance tunnel, the boundary water-balance residual handover must address the following evidence: State catchment and time boundaries and use controls to check seasonality. Define receptors, baselines and data gaps beforehand; causal judgements list alternatives, and mitigation is evaluated within the same monitoring boundary.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：將轉引水量視為地下水損失會錯估環境影響來源。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Treating diverted surface water as groundwater loss misidentifies environmental effects. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 明示集水區和時間邊界，以對照點核對季節變化。同步比較雨量、泉流、排水與對照井，核對儀器缺測和蓄水變化，對不同季節分別閉合水量帳。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。
knowledge.textEn: State catchment and time boundaries and use controls to check seasonality. Compare rainfall, spring flow, drainage and control wells, checking missing data and storage change and closing balances separately by season. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 本案「邊界水量差」的交付需回答：明示集水區和時間邊界，以對照點核對季節變化。預先定義受體、基線及資料缺口，任何因果判斷都需列出替代解釋，補救效果也用同一監測邊界評估。
knowledge.textEn: For New Wujie water-conveyance tunnel, the boundary water-balance residual handover must address the following evidence: State catchment and time boundaries and use controls to check seasonality. Define receptors, baselines and data gaps beforehand; causal judgements list alternatives, and mitigation is evaluated within the same monitoring boundary.

quiz.question: 要驗證「水量帳與環境受體」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Water balance and environmental receptors"?
options: 明示集水區和時間邊界，以對照點核對季節變化。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
混凝土強度達標就不必檢查接縫轉動與偏壓。
optionsEn: State catchment and time boundaries and use controls to check seasonality.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
Passing concrete strength eliminates the need to check joint rotation and uneven pressure.
quiz.explanation: 明示集水區和時間邊界，以對照點核對季節變化。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: State catchment and time boundaries and use controls to check seasonality. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 水量帳與環境受體：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Water balance and environmental receptors: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「邊界水量差」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Boundary water-balance residual” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 將轉引水量視為地下水損失會錯估環境影響來源。未量到的支流或時間錯位會產生假性水量損失，錯把所有減流歸於隧道可能導致無效補救。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Treating diverted surface water as groundwater loss misidentifies environmental effects. Unmeasured tributaries or timing mismatch create false losses; attributing every decrease to the tunnel can prompt ineffective mitigation. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：水量平衡需要明確時間和空間邊界，殘差不能直接歸因於某一裂隙；應用施工前基線和對照站區分自然變化與工程效應。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Baseline observations and control locations help separate natural variability from construction effects rather than equating correlation with causation.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「施工後泉水變少就能單獨證明隧道造成全部減流。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Reduced spring flow after construction alone proves the tunnel caused the entire change." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 將轉引水量視為地下水損失會錯估環境影響來源。未量到的支流或時間錯位會產生假性水量損失，錯把所有減流歸於隧道可能導致無效補救。
knowledge.textEn: Treating diverted surface water as groundwater loss misidentifies environmental effects. Unmeasured tributaries or timing mismatch create false losses; attributing every decrease to the tunnel can prompt ineffective mitigation.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「水量帳與環境受體」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Water balance and environmental receptors" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
將轉引水量視為地下水損失會錯估環境影響來源。
水體流過全程的時間必然等於洪峰抵達的時間。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Treating diverted surface water as groundwater loss misidentifies environmental effects.
Material travel time necessarily equals flood-peak arrival time.
quiz.explanation: 將轉引水量視為地下水損失會錯估環境影響來源。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Treating diverted surface water as groundwater loss misidentifies environmental effects. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.
